title: Captions
summary: Seven caption styles in the theme look, playing over the sample clip with its real word timings. Words fade up softly as they are spoken; nothing pops or bounces.
usage: In a storyboard: {"captions": "soft-word"}. Over footage use the cream styles (soft-word is the theme default; wide-caps, handwritten, serif-note, big-word). On the theme's pale paper cards (shot storyboards built from title cards and diagrams) cream text disappears: use "ink-pill" or "paper-slip" there. Styles: library/themes/lifestyle/captions/styles.js.
